svg.title: Periodic table in order of increasing atomic number
svg.desc: Periodic table of the 118 elements with official IUPAC symbols, arranged by increasing atomic number. Metals are blue, to the lower left of an orange staircase. Nonmetals are bronze, to the upper right. Boron, silicon, germanium, arsenic, antimony, and tellurium are gold. The lanthanides and actinides are shown in two rows below the main table.
